US Judge Orders Trump to Pay E. Jean Carroll $5.8 Million

A US judge has ordered Donald Trump to pay E. Jean Carroll $5.8 million following a jury's finding that he sexually abused and defamed her. This order comes after the Supreme Court rejected his appeal in the case. Trump is also appealing a separate $83 million defamation award to Carroll from a previous trial.
